answer: The velvet index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the meadow queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 277 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the ember. A 162 account operation therefore ties up 28 million dollars of idle capital. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
